kinds.A: copied, only imports/removed compatibility code changed
kinds.B: ported to Creator 3.8 API with the same contract

files.changes: Same add/remove/changeListener/send contract and priority order; string ids; no query channel, diagnostics port or bindSourceNotifier.
Sequence formula unchanged; seed via constructor; range() uses next(); sampleDistinctInPlace removed; weighted() added for endless dealing.
Layers reduced to Page/Popup/Guide/Toast; queues to Page/Popup/None.
2.x cc._RF.peek() registration replaced by a class decorator carrying bundle, path, layer, queue, transition.

Same hooks (onOpen, setInfo, changeListener, onShow, onShowFinish, onHide, onHideFinish, onClose); typed args instead of ViewArgs; ResourceLease by composition; per-view UIMask replaced by the UIRoot block node; no attachment/music/event-scene.
Backdrop and Content bound with @property instead of children[0]/[1] and nodeBindings arrays; no pause bus or legacy path opener.
cc.tween -> tween, opacity -> UIOpacity, stopAllActions -> Tween.stopAllByTarget; popup scale and page fade; clip transition dropped.

Open by class with bundle path; one instance per class; per-queue stacks hide/show previous top; ordered popup queue (enqueue); block input during transitions/loads; delayed loading indicator; back key; fixed queue index-out-of-range on close.
Layer roots placed in Boot.scene and bound with @property; no runtime root creation.
Vertical grid with visible-range node reuse on ScrollView.EventType.SCROLLING; loadData(items) and cell onRefresh contract kept; no source field maps, private API or injected configurators.
onRefresh(data, index) only; refresh-event wiring removed.
Promise API over assetManager bundles; load/loadDir/loadBundle; no DragonBones/remote loading.
Plain owner object (acquire/releaseAll) held by ViewBase instead of a node component.
Instance-owned key table with {name} templates; missing key throws; change event on the bus; no window dictionaries or traditional conversion.
Resident component with key/params; re-renders on language change.
JSON read/write/remove on sys.localStorage only; no cloud or remote queue.
IPlatform with WebPlatform only (simulated rewarded video); WeChat/Android providers deferred.
